items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: I called up his wife and I said, 'Jean'

ctx.x: Helen. I went down to the hospital to see George and he was under sedation and he looked terribly thin and I remember going out to get him some magazines, and he wasn't drinking of course, but he liked chocolates and I got him some cigarettes and when I was out, I called up his wife and I said, 'Jean' -- you said Helen, but her name was Jean.
